scope: Obligations R8, R0 and R9 of the rank-deficient route are PROVED, and the rank-deficient gap of the codimension-m coarea program is CLOSED: the general codimension-m coarea formula for C1 maps holds with no hypothesis on the critical set. With R1 through R7 that is ten of the route's thirteen numbered items. THIS IS NOT A SARD THEOREM: nothing is claimed about the measure of the set of critical VALUES. R10, N1 and N2 remain unproved. No hole migrated, no certificate added. The log-concave Cheeger-Buser line belongs to collaborator Wang Haocheng and was not touched.

main_results.R8: ae_hausdorffMeasure_inter_levelSet_eq_zero_of_local: a local null-slicing statement patches to a global one, by second countability; needs NO regularity of u and NO measurability of A
main_results.R0: ae_hausdorffMeasure_critical_inter_levelSet_eq_zero: for a C1 map the WHOLE critical set, where the differential fails to be surjective and not merely where the derivative vanishes, meets almost every level in an H^k-null set. No positivity of the codimension is needed: with a zero-dimensional target every linear map is surjective, the critical set is empty and the statement is vacuous rather than false
main_results.R9: coarea_of_contDiff: the codimension-m coarea formula with NO hypothesis on the critical set. No finiteness, boundedness, integrability or regular-value hypothesis; S an arbitrary Borel set, g an arbitrary measurable weight, no positivity of the codimension

what_this_supersedes.previous_conditional_formula: coarea_of_contDiff_of_critical_eq_zeroDeriv of Analysis/VectorCriticalSlice.lean assumed the derivative VANISHES wherever it fails to be surjective, which for m >= 2 is a genuine restriction
what_this_supersedes.witness_that_the_old_hypothesis_fails: its own audit exhibited the rank-one orthogonal projection of the plane, whose derivative is nowhere zero and nowhere surjective, so the hypothesis failed at EVERY point
what_this_supersedes.now: rank_deficient_witness_now_covered shows that witness is covered by R0, and strictly_extends_conditional derives the old conditional formula from the new one

the_route_in_one_paragraph: R1 stratifies the critical set by the exact rank of the differential into finitely many measurable layers. On a layer, R2 says the differential dies along the fibres of the regular component, R3 makes that quantitative with a locally uniform right-inverse bound, and R4 combines them into a tangential Lipschitz constant proportional to the approximation parameter. R7 runs the approximating partition on u itself and applies the Eilenberg bound INSIDE A FIBRE, where k + (m - r) = n - r is the right exponent, integrating against the PROVED regular coarea formula. R8 patches those neighbourhoods together by second countability, the finite union over r < m gives R0, and the critical part of the coarea equality then vanishes on both sides, giving R9.
where_the_exponent_is_repaired: the fibre. The same Eilenberg bound applied in the ambient space forces the exponent k + r; forcing it back to k puts mu_H[n-r] of a set of positive Lebesgue measure, that is infinity, on the right - exactly the obstruction the route's diagnostic N2 records.

explicitly_not_claimed.sard: NO Sard theorem is proved. R0 bounds the critical set INSIDE A LEVEL; nothing whatever is claimed about the measure of the set of critical VALUES, which for a merely C1 map may well be positive. Sharp finite-regularity Sard remains a direct hole and is untouched.
explicitly_not_claimed.regularity: the map is assumed C1, NOT Lipschitz
explicitly_not_claimed.fibre_measure: the normalized Hausdorff measure of the complementary dimension, in the repository's standing convention
explicitly_not_claimed.registration: no hole migrated, no certificate added, no Blueprint leanok scope widened; the dimension-free KLS bound remains open

scalar_consistency.honest_difference: both carry an extra 1 <= finrank V, as in every earlier round, because the codimension-m statements assume fibre dimension plus codimension equals ambient dimension

route_statement_file.why_not_edited: it is a committed historical route snapshot which the collaborator has already taken editing ownership of; the repository's way of recording that an obligation is met is for an audit client to copy its proposition verbatim and discharge it, which route_R8, route_R0 and route_R9 do
